scope: Hand-built S0-LL13-c and S0-LL19-b boundary fixture only; not a production TCR, complete layout, collector or selected D3 ABI.
note: Fixture NIL/cons addresses are local to these tests and do not select production canonical addresses.
boundary: The emitted adapter owns restoration of C SP and root/binding/VSP/TSP/CSP checkpoints on both ordinary and exceptional return; no safepoint occurs between helper exit and completed restoration.
results: The emitted fixture returns value0/nvalues. The TCR mv_base/count descriptor refers to a caller-owned VSP result region, not a second backing buffer. VSP grows upward; the caller reserves an aligned 32-byte region for at most six tagged values, retains it across the helper/cleanup, and releases it only after consuming the complete sequence. Zero values return fixture NIL. Candidate-specific argument placement remains D3 work.

restarts.0: Return all supplied values from the handler outside the unwound C helper.
restarts.1: Propagate the original exit after restoration.
restarts.2: Cleanup transfers again with a distinct tag after restoration.
